test(keepalive-r2 ②, c): through the relay, the lease after its session is still parked on the same socket and takes the session back

No loss, no new standby connect; A activates again through the same relay lease (video). 54/54 (with --real-directory
--old-host) under sh_run -NativeExe. Mutant: the lease gives its socket away and opens a new one -> the relay case
FAILs (lost: no pong).
